name: Athena 75 with PBTfans no signal R3
sourceText:
Athena 75: The Essence of Vigilance
Building on the strategic legacy of the 1800, the Athena 75 emerges as a more compact and refined instrument of intellect.
Its surface is etched with the realistic texture of owl plumage, a tribute to the silent flight and vigilant gaze of the goddess’s companion.
With a new tactical button positioned on the front right for instant command, the Athena 75 is the condensed essence of myth and metal—precision in its most agile form.
Case Design
The Athena 75 commands attention with an aesthetic that balances modern minimalism with powerful symbolism.
Compared to the 1800, the bottom plate features a fully engraved radial machined pattern. The intricately staggered lines beautifully replicate the natural texture of owl feathers, creating a sophisticated and multi-dimensional visual experience.
Small Screen, Big Expression The HD display supports up to 5 custom GIF uploads. Toggle through them instantly via hotkeys or the bottom-right key, making every boot-up a unique showcase of your personal style.
Function Meets Aesthetics The bottom-right features an integrated RGB strip and a multi-function badge key. Pre-configured for GIF switching, it can be customized to any key function. CNC-machined from full aluminum, the module color matches the bottom case perfectly for a premium, cohesive look.
Details From Within Both the internal weight and internal cover are crafted from premium stainless steel, enhanced by a refined machined texture. Even for the hidden internal structures, we uphold strict standards of precision machining and polishing—ensuring premium quality and consistent craftsmanship from the inside out.
Engineered for a Divine Typing Experience
Beneath its striking exterior, the Athena 75 is built with the discerning enthusiast in mind, offering a choice of premium typing experiences.
Optimized TOP Mount Structure
To minimize resonance and hollowness, the mounting points for the TOP structure are strategically placed to avoid the spacebar area. This results in a more uniform and satisfying sound signature.
Plate-Mount Silicone Dampeners
Silicone dampeners provide complete physical decoupling of the positioning plate from the upper housing. This design mitigates resonance conduction at its origin, significantly reducing structural noise
Engineered for Softness
Following a similar support distribution as the TOP Mount, the PCB Gasket is designed to provide a maximally soft, bouncy, and flexible typing experience.
Plateless Build Potential
Combine this mount with the solderable PCB to assemble your board without a plate. This "plateless" configuration is the ultimate choice for achieving maximum flex and a unique, deep sound profile.
Hotswap /Solder PCB Layout
*Please note that the plate mont stabilizers version plate do not support ISO Enter, Split Backspace, 7U Spacebar, or Split Left Shift layouts.

sourceText:
Inspiration
When I got the green light from GMK to run this set, I was beyond excited. Having grown up playing video games and spending time in arcades, this project gave me the perfect chance to reimagine those classics in a fresh way. GMK Arcade is a nod off to a classic theme, revamped with vibrant colours and filled with references to iconic games, all aimed at capturing that nostalgic arcade atmosphere.

Customize every detail. We’ll build, test, and ship it ready to type.
Case Design

This allows users to choose between a classic TOP Mount for a firm, responsive feel, or a PCB Gasket Mount for a softer, more flexible typing experience, catering to diverse preferences.

FAQs
What is the latency for the wired and dual-mode PCBs? Is the dual-mode latency significant?
The latency is 1.25ms for MX-style switches and 0.125ms for magnetic switches. As expected, the latency in dual-mode (wireless) will be slightly higher than in single-mode (wired).
Can I request a different color after making a purchase?
This pre-order is for our standard color options. However, we also offer a paid upgrade service for custom colors.
Custom color options are a pre-sale exclusive . They will not be available for the Tofu60 3.0 project after the pre-sale ends.
Will the design files be made public?
Yes, the design files (for the plate and battery filler) will be released for download after the Pre-order is completed.
Do you offer custom colors for the texture?
Yes, It's available
Can magnetic switches be used with a gasket mount?
Yes. Our magnetic switch solution supports an adjustable actuation point with 0.01mm increments. While technically it can go lower, 0.01mm is a stable and practical value that represents the physical limit of what most people can perceive. Smaller increments would only create inconvenience when configuring in the software.
Do the magnetic switches support an 8K polling rate?
Yes, it is a true 8K polling rate. However, considering the varying quality of switches on the market, we have added an option to change the polling rate in the top-right corner of the configurator website. If you are using lower-quality magnetic switches, you can switch to a lower polling rate to calibrate and improve performance.
Why is there only a dual-mode (Wired + Bluetooth) version and not a tri-mode (Wired + Bluetooth + 2.4G) version?
Our current firmware is based on an open-source solution that does not include a 2.4G wireless component. We believe dual-mode meets the needs of the vast majority of users. Furthermore, this keyboard features an ultra-low-power design, making it exceptionally energy-efficient. (From personal experience, I often lose the 2.4G dongles anyway.)
QC Standard
Upon receipt, the casing is considered acceptable if all six external surfaces (top, bottom, left, right, front, and back) are free from machining marks, stains, dents, and pinholes, and do not have any black dots larger than 1mm or scratches longer than 1mm.
The copper weight is considered acceptable if it does not have any black dots, pinholes, or blemishes larger than 1mm, and no scratches longer than 2mm.
Flaws and manufacturing artifacts that do not affect the overall external appearance are considered reasonable. This includes, but is not limited to: minor blemishes around screw holes, uneven internal coating, hook marks (from anodizing/painting) where the base color is exposed, and water marks, tool marks, or scratches on internal surfaces. Purchasing this product means you accept these terms.
Due to the significant weight difference between the top and bottom case parts, there may be slight color variations even when the same color is chosen for both.
Standards for RAW Finish
The RAW version is anodized and uncoated. It preserves the original look of the machined metal, including natural tool marks.
Acceptable Quality Standards (Not covered by warranty):
1. Minor scratches, tool paths, and small speck-like imperfections.
2. Variations in surface reflection or slight dark spots on the raw metal.
(RAW products are not sold as "flawless." By purchasing, you acknowledge and accept the inherent characteristics of this manufacturing process.)

Precautions & Usage Instructions
Warranty Notice: Do not attempt to disassemble the screen, hub housing, or spiral rod yourself. Unauthorized disassembly will void your warranty.
No Fast Charging: Do not use this product to fast-charge mobile phones or other devices, as high voltage/current may damage the internal components.
Keep Away from Liquids: Do not submerge the product in water or liquids to prevent short circuits, overheating, fire, or electric shock.
Voltage & Current Limits: Operate strictly within allowed limits (Rated Voltage: 3.75–5.25V | Total Rated Current: 0–3A).

FAQ
Q: Why does the HUB suddenly stop working?
A: The HUB features built-in over-current and reverse-current protection. Plugging or unplugging cables during operation may occasionally trigger this safety lock. Simply restarting your computer will clear the lock and restore functionality.
Q: Why is the device not recognized upon startup, requiring me to replug it?
A: Peripherals require a peak startup current. If your computer's USB port supplies insufficient initial power, the device may fail to boot. We recommend connecting an external 5V power supply or disabling the computer's USB power-saving mode.
Pro Tip: Set your PC motherboard to cut USB power when shut down. If USB ports stay powered after shutdown, the HUB retains its previous session address, causing a communication mismatch with the host upon reboot.
Q: Which USB port on my PC should I use?
A: Always connect to the motherboard USB 3.0 or 3.2 ports on the back of your computer tower. Red or green 10Gbps USB 3.2 ports are preferred, followed by blue 5Gbps USB 3.0 ports.
Q: How do I choose an external power adapter?
A: Use a standard phone power charger rated at 20W or higher. Ensure the adapter explicitly supports 5V/3A output (check the output label on the charger).
Q: When should I connect an external power supply?
A: Connect external power if you experience mouse frame drops, keyboard disconnection/key-drop issues, erratic port connections when moved, or if connected devices fail to power on during boot.

The Agar Mini represents the latest evolution in the esteemed Agar series, distilling its signature design language into a new compact form factor.
This model preserves the elegant, curved aesthetic iconic to the lineage, while further streamlining the layout to create a highly portable and efficient input device.
Appearance
Classic Design, Unmatched Portability
The Agar Mini translates the iconic Agar design language into a more refined and compact form factor, retaining its signature gentle curves while introducing a delightful new aesthetic. A key feature is its ultra-low front height, which is engineered for superior ergonomic comfort, allowing for extended typing sessions without the need for a wrist rest.
For ultimate convenience, the Agar Mini comes complete with a bespoke storage pouch. This makes it easy to pack and carry, establishing it as the perfect companion for use at home, in the office, and on the go.
Ergonomic Angle and Premium Weight System
The Agar Mini's 9° typing angle creates a powerful stance. Its interchangeable weight is crafted exclusively from PVD mirror-polished stainless steel, adding striking visual contrast and a premium feel.
The Art of the Curve: Sculpting a New Form
The Agar Mini challenges the conventional perception of a metal keyboard. Sha r p ang les do not define its s ide profi le, but by a dynamic interplay of fluid lines reminiscent of a dancer in motion. The result is a design that feels both understated and confidently present.
This sculptural form is achieved through the use of complex, compound curves—a deliberate choice that, while demanding in its manufacturing, is essential to achieving the sophisticated aesthetic we envisioned. For us, this pursuit of an elevated finish is non-negotiable.
Front Profile: Gentle by Design
The front profile highlights the Agar series' signature design cue: soft, inwardly tapering side curves that create a lighter, more gentle visual impression.
Departing from a conventional linear edge, the front lip is defined by a smooth, organic curve. This detail reinforces the keyboard's overall gentle aesthetic, resulting in a design that is both visually pleasing and inherently inviting to the hand.
PCB Gasket Mount
A Revolution in Assembly: The Proprietary Mounting System
The Agar Mini utilizes the same mounting structure as the Agar, designed to replace conventional O-ring systems. This design eliminates the need for specific gasket ring sizes, clip-in stabilizers, and complex foam configurations.
The core of the system is a bespoke set of structural silicone components, precision-molded to a 50A durometer hardness. This allows the core assembly to be installed or removed in approximately two seconds, offering an unparalleled level of efficiency without compromising on a premium typing experience.

Installation is simpler: It's a 2-second, snap-in process.
It's more compatible: No need to worry about specific stabilizer sizes.
The typing experience is better: The feel is more stable and the sound is deeper.

Wired: Flash via VIA, VIAL, or QMK Toolbox.
Dual-Mode: Generate your firmware on zmk.studio and flash the file in bootloader mode.
We provide detailed guides and videos for both processes.

This will save much time and frustration of attempting to do each spring individually. As this has a higher viscosity than Krytox GPL 105, it is more applicable for lubing switch housings and stems too.
